title: What do you want to create?
subtitle: Pick a type: you set it up on the left and see the result live on the right.

regular.title: Regular
regular.body: A classic questionnaire that ends with a custom thank-you message of your choice.
regular.label: Best for surveys

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
diagnostic.body: Score each respondent and place them into tiers, each with its own result and action plan.
diagnostic.label: Best for assessments

quizFunnel.title: Quiz Funnel
quizFunnel.body: Turn store visitors into buyers with a guided quiz that recommends the right product at the end.
quizFunnel.label: Imports from your store

chaining.title: Chaining
chaining.body: Add your questions plus a prompt; the answers and prompt are used to generate a tailored questionnaire.
chaining.label: Best for AI generation
